evidence.topic: Local pinned ODA snapshot versus currently hosted same-label PDF

evidence.topic: Local production parser, test seam, and observed AC1024 page
observed: Production parser reads header 0x08 into cSize, 0x0C into pi.uSize, one 32-bit word at 0x10, treats 0x14 as unknown, and validates checksums at 0x18/0x1C. It compares mapped dataSize to cSize and bounds cSize inside physical map size minus the 32-byte header, but does not directly require header 0x0C to equal map extent.

The parser uses pi.uSize for output-cap/size checks and requires cSize == uSize for compressed==1. These are source-conflict audit points, not proven bugs. sectionBufferCapacity already takes max(written-page capacity, rounded logical size); existing tests exercise only helper arithmetic and the reader-matrix seam overrides production parseDataPage.

For title_block-iso.dwg AC1024 AcDb:AcDbObjects page 0x0b, map size is 0x6a0, mapped payload 0x67a, start 0x1d000; decrypted header 0x08=0x67a, 0x0C=0x6a0, 0x10 low word=0x1d000 and upper word zero. Checksums at 0x18/0x1C match; reader reports operationSucceeded=true, legacyError=0, and decompresses a 0x7400 window. The CLI later fails at unrelated LAYOUT export preflight.
evidence.planAction: Add one fast in-memory selector reaching production parseDataPage under existing PAR-14/7BE. Assert safe declared-size capacity, short final logical tail, exact published sectionSize, failure atomicity, and retry using a locally authored vector anchored to the trace. Defer disputed field-role and 64-bit offset assertions until the normative source is reconciled.

observed: As of 2026-10-17, #1294 and #1358 remain open; #1358 still has cla_needed. The issue has multiple public AC1032 drawings from varied histories plus a control.

The PR author reports three public drawings matching ODA File Converter 25.6 modelspace counts, 270 passing local tests, 146 corpus conversions with no worse outputs, and a 190-drawing sweep improving 160 to 166 OK. The original reporter later verified 83,917 objects on a private case and byte-identical output on the other 91/92 drawings tested.

A Sep. 26 independent commenter reported a LibreDWG 0.14 Classes section of 89,089 bytes against an 89,088-byte estimate; an allocation-only local backport recovered 293 classes/4,100 objects including two WIPEOUTs, while other 73/74 outputs were byte-identical. The commenter had not separately tested the PR page-bound guard and could not share the source DWG.
